title: The Steadfast Love of God Endures

questions.question: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The steadfast love of God endures when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:1 (ESV): "The steadfast love of God endures all the day."

questions.question: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, you worker of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:2 (ESV): "Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, you worker of deceit."

questions.question: You love evil more than good, and lying more than speaking what is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:3 (ESV): "You love evil more than good, and lying more than speaking what is right."

questions.question: You love all words that devour, O deceitful what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:4 (ESV): "You love all words that devour, O deceitful tongue."

questions.question: But God will break you down forever; he will snatch and tear you from your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:5 (ESV): "...he will snatch and tear you from your tent;"

questions.question: He will uproot you from the land of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:5 (ESV): "...he will uproot you from the land of the living."

questions.question: The righteous shall see and fear, and shall laugh at whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:6 (ESV): "The righteous shall see and fear, and shall laugh at him, saying,"

questions.question: See the man who would not make God his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:7 (ESV): "See the man who would not make God his refuge,"

questions.question: But trusted in the abundance of his riches and sought refuge in his own what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:7 (ESV): "...and sought refuge in his own destruction!"

questions.question: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:8 (ESV): "But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God."

questions.question: I trust in the steadfast love of God when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:8 (ESV): "I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever."

questions.question: I will thank you forever, because you have done it. I will wait for your name, for it is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:9 (ESV): "...I will wait for your name, for it is good,"

questions.question: This Psalm is associated with Doeg the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52 Title: "...when Doeg, the Edomite, came and told Saul..."

questions.question: The righteous shall laugh at him, saying: "See the man who would not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:7 (ESV): "...but trusted in the abundance of his riches"

questions.question: He will snatch and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah. Who will do this?
questions.explanation: Psalm 52:5 (ESV): "But God will break you down forever..."

key_verse_text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God. I trust in the steadfast love of God forever and ever.
